name: Brendon Small
bio: Brendon Small (born February 15, 1975) is an American stand-up comedian, animator, actor, voice actor, writer, director, producer, singer and musician known for co-creating the animated series Home Movies (1999–2004; with Loren Bouchard) and Metalocalypse (2006–13; with Tommy Blacha). He is also known for creating, performing and writing the music for the virtual melodic death metal band, Dethklok.
